title: Company Matrix Edit Tier dialog: the first percentage field opens as a raw decimal while the other twenty open percent-formatted
stepsToReproduce: Wait for the Company Matrix grid to render a non-zero tier-row count.
In the tier row labelled '0 - 1500', click the Edit control (the row's second button, title=Edit).
In the dialog 'Editing 0 - 1500', WITHOUT typing or clicking into any field, read the value of all 21 inputs.
Compare the value of input index 0 against the values of inputs 1 through 20.
expectedBehavior: All 21 percentage inputs open in one consistent format. The grid displays this row as 17% in the corresponding column, so the dialog should show 17% in every field that holds that value.
actualBehavior: Input index 0 (Non-Peak Booking Windows Days 0-15) opens rendering the raw decimal 0.17, while inputs 1 through 20 open percent-formatted (17%, 17%, 17%, 20%, 20%, 20%, 12%, 12%, 12%, 12%, 15%, 15%, 15%, 7%, 7%, 7%, 7%, 10%, 10%, 10%). The same underlying value is presented in two different formats inside one dialog. Because the field also accepts decimals below 1 by multiplying them by 100, a user who edits around the pre-filled 0.17 can reasonably misread the field's expected unit.
mcpEvidence: Live-verified 2026-08-19 on office 1604 (cloudapps-e2e) via playwright-cli, across three independent worker runs using three different interaction methods and eleven fresh dialog opens in total. Run dsm-cmx-dialog-0819 observed 0.17 on input 0 across four fresh opens. Run dsm-cmx-boundary-0819 opened the dialog three further times and read inputs 0, 1 and 2 before any interaction on each open, getting 0.17 / 17% / 17% every time, and additionally enumerated all 21 values on a fresh open confirming exactly one input is raw-decimal. Run dsm-cmx-tiebreak-0819 read input 0 as 0.17 on open in all four of its fresh dialog opens. Nothing was saved in any run.
